name: Woodland Retreat
tagline: A single 40-foot room in the trees, with the porch turned to the view.
description: One 40-foot high-cube container holds a sleeping room, bath, kitchen and living space. A generous screened porch and a small deck extend the living area into the forest. The long side faces the view; the entry and path stay behind.

zones.name: Sleeping
zones.accessibility: A 1.5 m turning circle does not fit with the double bed; an accessible variant needs a longer room or smaller bed.

zones.name: Bathroom
zones.accessibility: 2.1 m clear length; a 1.5 m turning circle needs a layout review.

zones.name: Kitchen
zones.accessibility: 1.6 m clear in front of the counter; provide a lowered work section.

zones.name: Living
zones.accessibility: Sliding door to the screened porch; 0.9 m clear route.

porches.note: Screened outdoor room facing the view.

foundation.note: Type, depth, frost and rock need geotechnical review.

features.outdoor: 4.4 × 3.05 m screened porch plus 1.2 m deck
features.solar: Solar array on the main roof
features.green_roof: Not included; can be tested as an option
features.accessibility: Step-free porch route is intended; bathroom and sleeping turning space need redesign.
features.environment: Small footprint, external insulation and a replaceable rainscreen.

materials.material: Reclaimed 40 ft / 20 ft ISO high-cube steel containers
materials.source: Documented salvage; inspect structure, coatings, prior cargo and floor treatment
materials.disclosure: Reuse avoids new steel but adds transport, reinforcement and insulation. Not automatically lower impact than timber.
Continuous external insulation reduces thermal bridging. Thickness and moisture performance need hygrothermal review.

materials.material: Reclaimed or certified timber battens and boards
materials.disclosure: Replaceable, repairable, but needs durable species, ventilation and fire review.

materials.material: Timber frame, decking, insect screen and steel connectors
materials.disclosure: Separate from the container envelope so it can be repaired or removed.

materials.material: Membrane, PV modules and optional extensive green roof
materials.disclosure: Green roofs add saturated weight and maintenance. PV output depends on orientation, shading and snow.

provenance.method: Original concept schema and geometry for Containers Hamlet Design Lab. Not a measured, engineered or permit-ready design.
provenance.verification: None. No architect, engineer, building official or accessibility consultant has reviewed this concept.

status: concept only; not reviewed; not for construction

trellises.note: Independent native-climber trellis on the west end.
